purpose: Gate 2: separates real Whop sandbox observations from local simulations and unverified behaviour.
seamlessSwitching: disabled. No upgrade/downgrade route exists; an active, canceling, past-due or unresolved membership blocks another checkout (PBC01), and an open checkout is resumed or refused (PBC02).

legend.provider: Observed from the real Whop sandbox (signed webhook delivery or Whop API reads).
legend.simulation: Local or isolated-database test that drives the real app code with controlled time or mocked Whop responses. Not provider evidence.
legend.blocked: Not observed and not reproducible without an owner action or a provider capability.

rows.case: Actual subsequent Whop renewal charge and its webhooks
rows.reason: No sandbox time control and no daily billing. Prepared: hidden probe plan_ph23AtuxtNWzD (1-day trial, 7-day period, $1). After an owner purchase with test card 4242, the first scheduled charge is due after 1 day and the renewal after 8. Observe with scripts/observe-whop-sandbox.mjs.

rows.case: Replacement subscription (cancel then repurchase, or change plan)
rows.reason: No plan-change API exists. Today a new membership after a canceled one gets its own allowance; overlap is prevented (PBC01). Leak to watch: a support refund plus immediate cancel, then a repurchase in the same month, leaves the refunded period's unspent credits until month end (bounded by one month's allowance; access ends with the old membership, so they are usable only through the new one). Policy D5/D7.

rows.case: Full refund of a paid subscription payment (Whop API)
rows.evidence: whop-sandbox-observations.json 2026-10-12T23:22Z: pay_JVp4TjClPsS0Hs refunded $29 via POST /payments/{id}/refund; status stays 'paid', substatus 'refunded', refunded_amount 29, refunded_at not set; membership (already canceled) unchanged

rows.case: Refunded payment is never used as allocation evidence
rows.evidence: src/lib/billing/check-billing-reconcile-job.cjs uses the exact refunded shape observed in the sandbox; plan evidence 'evidence_refunded' is unusable (20261012110000)

rows.case: Refund of a period with credits already granted
rows.reason: Policy D7: granted credits are never clawed back today; access ends with the membership. Needs an owner decision, then a sandbox refund on an active membership.

rows.case: Chargeback / dispute
rows.reason: The sandbox documents no way to raise a dispute. The webhook handler resolves refund.* and dispute.* to the membership and re-reads current state; untested against a real dispute.

rows.case: Payment failure / past-due
rows.reason: Prepared: hidden probe plan_JWikpAgY1kqqI. An owner purchase with test card 4000 0000 0000 0341 saves the card; the first scheduled charge after 1 day declines (documented). Then observe past_due, POST /payments/{id}/retry and the app's access gate.

rows.case: API version pinning
rows.evidence: Sandbox list calls return 400 without Api-Version-Date and 200 with 2025-01-01 (2026-10-12T23:22Z). The app pins 2025-01-01 on every request (src/lib/billing/whop.ts). The production webhook endpoint must also be pinned (RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md).

rows.case: Daily billing for fast renewal tests
rows.evidence: POST /variants with billing_period 1 is refused: 'You cannot offer daily subscriptions'. Probes use a 1-day trial plus a 7-day period instead (whop-sandbox-probes.json).

ownerActionsToClose: Sandbox only, test cards only: buy plan_ph23AtuxtNWzD with 4242 4242 4242 4242 and plan_JWikpAgY1kqqI with 4000 0000 0000 0341 (links in whop-sandbox-probes.json). Then tell Claude/Codex to observe after 1 day and after 8 days.
Decide D5 (replacement) and D7 (refunds) in docs/RELEASE_DECISIONS.md.
